dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Hold it, I have to stop you right there. Sorry, the name's Mack.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius are carrying out a training exercise near Falcon Coast. Access is temporarily denied to the public.

choices.text: But I don't see any knights on the beach...

response.speaker: Mack
response.text: They're still rounding up the troops, but they'll be arriving shortly.

response.speaker: Mack
response.text: Please return to the city. Combat training is boring to watch, and we don't want to risk you getting injured.

choices.text: But there are monsters on the beach...

response.speaker: Mack
response.text: Exactly. They will serve as targets for the knights participating in the training exercise.

response.speaker: Mack
response.text: Please return to the city. Combat training is boring to watch, and we don't want to risk you getting injured.
